GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   C. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.

3. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   C. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.

4. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

6. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   C. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   B. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

9. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   C. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   D. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   C. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   C. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.

15. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   D. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   C. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Weather as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Soils and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Tourism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Transport and Communication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
